name: Your AI's top picks
tagline: Let your AI do the reading
idea: Every 2 weeks the AI scores each stock from 0 to 100, and the top score should get a position. Use your own AI.
rationale: Nobody can read every news story and financial report about every company, but an AI can. You run our prompt in the AI you already use; it scores each stock, and the strategy signals the top one. You see whether all that reading turns into better picks.

rules.text: Every `2 weeks` you run the AI round: copy the prompt, paste it into your AI, paste its answer back.
The stock with the top score gets a signal for one step, until the budget is used.
If you skip a round, there's no signal that round.
